cohort: 17 patients with an anatomopathological diagnosis of an endometriosis node in a gynaecological scar presentation who had undergone surgery between January 2000 to January 2012 at Hospital 12 de Octubre
finding: A high level of suspicion is required to diagnose gynaecological scar endometriosis, which should be suspected in the differential diagnosis of scar masses in reproductive-aged women.
